en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Miu is sitting down, looking like her usual
haughty self.
<CLT=cltMIND>Seems like she's alone...

Remember not to tell her about the plan.
There's a chance she's..."<CLT=cltSTRONG>it<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"...
Yeah, I know.

Let's give her the cameras and sensors
before she gets in a bad mood.

She seems like the kind of
girl to change her mind suddenly...
Morning, Miu.

Well, if it isn't flat-chested Kaede.
What do you and your pathetic tits want?
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll just pretend I didn't hear that.

Um...I have a small favor to ask of you, Miu.
Right, Shuichi?

Y-Yeah. Actually, there's something
that we want you to make...

We found cameras and security sensors
in the warehouse, and, ah...

Do you think you could make cameras that
<CLT=cltSTRONG>detect movement and take pictures<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

As in, it would automatically take a picture
if the motion sensor detects something?
The hell you gonna use that for?

Ah, to...keep Monokuma under surveillance.
We might learn important information.
Y-Yeah, exactly that.

Please, Miu... We need your help to get
everyone out of here.
Ah, okay. I get it now.
My answer is no!
What?

You plebs got a lotta nerve askin' ME
for a favor!

Were you grubs in a past life? Is that why you
don't understand basic human courtesy?

I'll forgive you just this once. Now get outta
here before I whip out the bug spray!
Hah-hahaha!
<CLT=cltMIND>Without thinking, my body moved on its own...
Please, Miu!
Heeeeeee!

I really want to get out of here with everyone!
And to do that, I need your help!
So...please! I'm begging you!
K-Kaede!
Shuichi...?
I'm begging you, too.

We could really use your help, Miu.
Please...

Wh-What the hell...?
Quit bowing to me...
No, I won't stop.

I'm gonna stay like this until you say 
you'll do it, Miu!
I'll do it for however long it takes!
Wh-Who the hell uses bowing as a threat?
F-Fine, I'll do it... Okay?
What!? Really!?
<CLT=cltMIND>I grasped Miu's hand.
Heeee!

Thank you, I owe you! Even after we escape,
I'll owe you forever and ever and ever!
I-I'm not...doing this for you guys...

My <CLT=cltSTRONG>research lab in the garden<CLT=cltNORMAL> just opened
up, so...
I...I was already thinkin' about...checkin' it out...

S-So...can I have my hand back now? Cuz
this is startin' to creep me out...
Oh! Sorry, I was just so happy.
But...are your hands always this clammy?
Heeee!

A-Anyway...bring me the security sensors
and cameras before I change my mind...

I'll be waiting in my research lab in the
garden!

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu wobbled out of the dining hall as if
she had been thrown off balance...

Thank god... I'm glad we managed to convince
her.

Let's go to the warehouse to get the
cameras and sensors right away.
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to ask Miu about the cameras...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wish I had a big TV like this at my house.
I'll ask Dad to get me one after I escape.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Dining Hall Rules"

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to ask Miu about the cameras...

<CLT=cltMIND>We're going to the warehouse, right?
It's pretty far from here, though.
